description: This file contains server-side event handlers and logic for the 'EditMCQ' page in an online examination system. It includes UI event handling for navigation buttons, course selection dropdowns, and session management.

classes.name: EditMCQ
classes.description: Partial class for the code-behind of the 'EditMCQ' ASP.NET page, managing UI logic for course selection and navigation.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles page load event; currently empty.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Transfers user to the Admin Panel page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Transfers user to the Admin Queue page.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Transfers user to the Admin Leaderboard page.

methods.name: selectB_Click
methods.description: Populates the course dropdown based on selected semester.

methods.name: searchB_Click
methods.description: Stores selected course in session state.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user and transfers to login page.

methods.name: selectSemesterDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Updates course list based on semester selection.
